artworks.title: The Daughters of Cecrops Open the Casket Entrusted to Them by Minerva
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three women and a child in a wooded landscape. The drawing features three women standing and leaning against a large tree. The central figure is engaging with her surroundings, while the woman on the right appears to be in conversation. The woman on the left is facing away, observing the landscape. A child is seated in a basket-like structure, playing or holding an object. The landscape is lush with trees and foliage. The drawing style shows attention to detail in the trees, leaves, and garments. A bird is perched on a branch above them, and a distant structure is visible toward the right. The scene conveys a sense of calm and timelessness.

artworks.title: Coronis Changed into a Crow
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological sea scene with ships and two central figures. The drawing features a muscular figure holding a trident and cape, standing in the surf as they engage with a winged figure stepping lightly over the waves. In the background, several ships with full sails navigate through the choppy sea under a cloud-streaked sky. On the left, sea creatures emerge from the water. The style suggests classic mythological themes typical of a detailed and dynamic etching focused on movement and expression. The composition balances the serene and tumultuous elements of the sea, highlighted by the interaction between the figures and natural forces.

artworks.title: Apollo Killing Coronis
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. The artwork features a partially draped female figure reclining amidst a natural landscape of trees and shrubs. To the right, a figure is posed with an archer’s stance, a bowstring drawn. Above, a bird soars through the sky, which is rendered with swirling clouds. The background is detailed with an undulating line of trees and rolling hills, populated by smaller figures who appear to be observing or participating in an event. The scene is executed in a classical style with fine lines and hatching for shading.

artworks.title: Landscape with Mercury Raising His Sword to Kill a Sleeping Argus
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.6 x 25.9 cm (7 5/16 x 10 3/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing depicting a mythological scene. The image shows a figure near a tree holding a thick branch, with another figure resting at the tree's base. A cow stands nearby, while a dynamic dog is positioned to the right. In the background are clouds and a structure or temple. The artwork features intricate line work and shading, creating a classical and illustrative texture.

artworks.title: Lycaon Changed into a Wolf
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a print depicting a scene involving a character undergoing a transformation near a banquet table. On the left, a man wearing draped cloth and a crown on his head sits under an awning at the head of the feast table, expending one arm out to the right. Next to him, a nude man stands behind the table holding a pitcher and cup. In the center of the table is a circular platter set with indistinct items, including one that looks like a small arm. On the far right, a person appears to turn from the table towards a doorway, their body facing the right and their head turned over their shoulder to face us. They have the body of a man, partially covered with cloth, but the head of a wolf-like animal. A large eagle is emerging from under the table, looking towards the person on the right. In the background, there is a large blaze and buildings filled with smoke and fire.

artworks.title: The Age of Iron
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.2 x 26 cm (7 3/16 x 10 1/4 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a scene featuring a colossal figure and various detailed elements. The central focus is on a giant, muscular figure standing with one foot on a cannon, holding a large sword and another weapon. Around the figure, smaller characters exhibit various expressions and actions. 

In the background, a landscape unfolds with a castle, mountains, and a town partially obscured by smoke or clouds. Several figures are engaged in activities like carrying weapons or pointing towards the colossal figure. 

To the right, Justice with scales and a sword hovers above the scene amidst clouds. The scene is intricately rendered with fine lines and crosshatching, reflecting allegorical and classical themes.

artworks.title: Jupiter Taking Counsel from the Gods about the Destruction of the Universe
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered in a celestial setting. The drawing shows several seated figures in a crescent shape formation. In the upper left corner, two figures are featured prominently, one appearing crowned and the other holding a staff. Clouds and swirling lines fill the sky above, while the figures are intricately detailed and animated. The artwork showcases meticulous craftsmanship and fine details.

artworks.title: The Age of Bronze
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image features a monochrome etching depicting a tall woman in flowing drapery holding a staff. Scattered weapons and a body of water are visible in the foreground, with busy men constructing a wall to the left. The landscape extends into the distance with various activities and structures, including mountains, a winding road, and cloudy skies. The detailed line work and cross-hatching enhance depth and texture in the composition.

artworks.title: Neptune Plotting the Destruction of Man
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.6 x 26.1 cm (7 5/16 x 10 1/4 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures interacting with water in a natural landscape. In the foreground, several muscular figures are engaged in the task of channeling and pouring water from large urns or vessels. The scene is dynamic, with a variety of poses and flowing lines. In the background, mountainous terrain is visible with a waterfall. A figure in the upper-right stands on a wave or spout of water, holding a trident. The figures and landscape are detailed with intricate linework, and the sky features wispy clouds.

artworks.title: Deucalion and Pyrra Repeopling the Earth
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.5 x 26 cm (7 5/16 x 10 1/4 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient mythological scene. The composition shows a rocky landscape with a central temple-like structure against dramatic cliff formations. In the foreground, there are robust, muscular figures in dynamic postures interacting with the environment. They seem engaged in expressive actions involving stones or the ground. The middle ground includes rolling hills and a waterway spreading into the distance with other figures. The sky above has swirling clouds. The detailed, fine lines and etching technique lend a sense of classical timelessness to the image.

artworks.title: Daphne Changed into a Laurel Tree
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.5 x 26 cm (7 5/16 x 10 1/4 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a transformation scene. The image shows a figure transforming into a tree, with branches sprouting from the head and fingers. Another figure holding a bow is nearby. The background has rocky terrain, distant mountains, and a village. A small winged figure resembling Cupid is in the sky. There is flowing script below the scene. The drawing features detailed lines and hatching for texture.

artworks.title: The River God Peneus Surrounded by Other Divinities
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a gathering of figures beside a rocky formation. A seated bearded figure gestures towards a group below by a stream. Trees and foliage suggest the horizon. The engraving features detailed line work with cross-hatching and fine lines for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, in black and white. In the distance, more trees and a tower-like structure are visible.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Io
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.4 x 24.9 cm (6 7/8 x 9 13/16 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures amidst a dramatic landscape. The image shows two central figures in dynamic poses. The scene is set in a rocky environment with dark, swirling textures. On the left, a separate scene is contained within a cloud-like formation, depicting a smaller figure guiding a cow. The drawing employs contrasts of light and shadow to highlight the figures and create movement. The textures are detailed, capturing the flow of fabric and the ruggedness of the natural elements surrounding the figures.

artworks.title: Phaeton Asking for the Chariot
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: plate: 18.5 x 26 cm (7 5/16 x 10 1/4 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a scene inspired by mythology, featuring architectural elements and numerous figures. The composition depicts muscular, nude figures in a classical architectural setting with columns and a curved archway. A central figure in a robe and laurel wreath holds a staff and seems to be interacting with another figure seated on a raised platform covered in fabric. The seated figure is surrounded by smaller figures in various positions that suggest devotion, pleading, or assistance. The intricately detailed background shows clouds, typical of traditional engravings. The dynamic scene shows characters in expressive stances, and there are objects like rakes and harvested crops hinting at a theme related to labor or harvest. The style and shading techniques are precise and detailed, resembling the influence of Renaissance engraving practices.

artworks.title: Clymene Urging Phaeton to Find Helios
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a scene under a tree with figures pointing toward the sky. In the foreground, there are several figures, including a woman gesturing upwards. She is sitting at the base of a large tree, with branches spreading across the top. Another figure embraces her. Two additional figures are on the left side of the scene on a path leading into the distance where there's architecture nestled within rolling hills. The sky has clouds and a radiant celestial group, emphasized by lines indicating light or radiance. The intricate line work captures the detailed texture of the scene.

artworks.title: Chaos: The Untangling of Chaos, or the Creation of the Elements
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg

artworks.title: Pan and Syrinx
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.6 x 25.4 cm (6 15/16 x 10 in.),c ut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is an intricate drawing of a mythological scene. In the image, a character is partially covered by drapery and surrounded by reeds. A muscular figure with horns confronts the central character. In the foreground, a reclining figure is shown near shells and water. Two additional figures observe the scene from a distance under a cloudy sky within a lush landscape. A Latin inscription at the bottom enhances the storytelling. The drawing features detailed lines and shading, typical of classical or Baroque engravings.

artworks.title: The Golden Age
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.5 x 26.2 cm (7 5/16 x 10 5/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a mythological scene with various figures set in a lush landscape. The scene features numerous figures, both adult and childlike, engaging in different activities. Some figures are under large leafy trees, while others interact with each other or reach for branches. A prominent figure lies on a cloud above. The composition includes swirling clouds, a flowing stream, and mountains in the background. The artistic style resembles classical or mythological engravings, emphasizing harmony and balance with intricate details of natural and divine elements.

artworks.title: The Giants Climbing the Heavens
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.5 x 26.2 cm (7 5/16 x 10 5/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological battle scene. The artwork showcases a chaotic battle among numerous figures in a turbulent landscape. A central gigantic figure wearing a crown and wielding weapons is engaged in combat with other figures around it. Various entities are depicted in dynamic poses, some flying and wielding weapons amidst clouds and mountains. The sun in the background adds to the dramatic effect of the scene. The drawing captures the intensity and grandeur of mythological conflicts through detailed lines and energetic compositions.

artworks.title: Village Scene with Workers in a Field and at Rest
artworks.artist: Caspar Johann Nepomuk Scheuren
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a park with tall trees, a structure with spires in the distance, hills, fields, and figures in period attire gathered along a path and scattered throughout the landscape. The etching technique uses fine lines to depict textures and shadows in a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Fishing Village with Boats on the Shore
artworks.artist: Caspar Johann Nepomuk Scheuren
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a tranquil riverside scene with small boats near the water's edge. Tall trees fill the composition, creating a natural arch over houses and figures below. The brushstrokes are intricate, emphasizing texture in the trees and structures. The palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of black and white. The scene is balanced by the elements of water, boats, trees, and buildings, creating a detailed depiction of a serene, rustic environment.

artworks.title: Mountain View with Lake
artworks.artist: Caspar Johann Nepomuk Scheuren
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from an elevated viewpoint. In the foreground, two figures stand on a rocky outcrop among trees. Beyond them is a body of water surrounded by hills. The horizon shows a range of mountains with detailed hatching and lines. The mountains dominate the scene, with their peaks outlined against the sky. The style resembles intricate etching techniques, using varied line work for depth and texture. The color scheme is black and white, emphasizing contrast and detail. The overall effect is a detailed and contemplative scene of natural beauty.

artworks.title: Hamlet with Yorick's Skull
artworks.artist: Caspar Johann Nepomuk Scheuren
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a full-body portrait standing in a graveyard. The individual is in an upright position with their torso slightly turned, arms crossed over their chest, one hand holding a skull. The person's facial features are partially obscured, with the head slightly tilted, a beard, and long hair. They are dressed in a dark robe or cloak that drapes to the ground. Several large gravestones stand around them, with vegetation, leaves, and branches scattered around. The background is filled with sweeping lines and shading, suggesting an overcast sky.

artworks.title: Watchtower on a Cliff with a Stream
artworks.artist: Caspar Johann Nepomuk Scheuren
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an old tower on a rocky cliff. The tower is positioned on high ground, surrounded by cliffs and dense foliage. The etching technique uses precise lines and cross-hatching to illustrate texture on the rocks and trees. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying black, gray, and white tones. Lush trees with twisted branches fill the foreground, while distant mountains are faintly visible in the background. Birds are depicted flying in the sky.
